summary:
• Reflection Beam — an open‑source 501‑billion‑parameter text model for coding, agentic tasks and scientific work, offering near‑state‑of‑the‑art performance on commodity hardware.
• Whirl — a self‑hostable full‑stack AI chat application built on Next.js and Convex that lets you plug any LLM, persistent memory and tools, enabling rapid internal chatbot prototypes.
• AI System Design — a curated open‑source tutorial collection that walks developers through building LLM pipelines, retrieval‑augmented generation and autonomous agents, accelerating product prototyping.
• Instinct — an AI agent you can add to chats on iOS, Android or web, coordinating plans and tasks without requiring participants to install app.
• TikTok AI shopping assistant — a conversational tool that guides users through product details, sizing and checkout, keeping commerce inside the TikTok feed and streamlining purchases.
• Cowork cloud version — moves model inference and the VM to remote servers, giving uninterrupted performance across devices and enhancing security by isolating sessions.
